license_caveat: HF API license value is metadata from model card; inspect the full license text for intended usage. GitHub NOASSERTION is retained where SPDX could not be determined; do not assume MIT.
interpretation: API lastModified is repository metadata timestamp, not necessarily model publication date. Downloads/likes are point-in-time counters and may change. README snapshots document model IDs, license, context, hardware guidance, and caveats. NOASSERTION is preserved when GitHub did not provide an SPDX license.
